svg.title: Your idea becomes something useful — and helps the next person
svg.desc: A person and a capable articulated machine work together at one engineering bench. The person sketches a need; the machine constructs a first part and hands it over. Human testing finds blocked access, feedback updates shared knowledge, and the machine produces a visibly revised second part. Real examples and a MANUFACTURER GUIDE contribute source, edition, limits. A messy knowledge lattice organizes into a topic tree. Wireframe objects become an enclosure, bracket and thermal device, checked before making. Human-reviewed feedback returns to improve the next design. A second maker receives the learned design and constructs its next useful part. Original conceptual artwork, not a hardware simulation or automatic model training.
